mapper.insert: insert into seckill_order( user_id, activity_id, goods_id, order_id, source, channel, original_price, seckill_price, status, out_trade_no, create_time, update_time ) values( #{userId}, #{activityId}, #{goodsId}, #{orderId}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{seckillPrice}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select user_id, activity_id, goods_id, order_id, source, channel, original_price, seckill_price, status, out_trade_no from seckill_order where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo}
select user_id, activity_id, goods_id, order_id, source, channel, original_price, seckill_price, status, out_trade_no from seckill_order where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId}
